Abrir el remate demasiado tarde.
tips: Practica el Full Feilong hasta dominar el giro con la pierna extendida.
Después agrega la patada extra.
Usa una cama elástica para la caída.

terms.meaning: Remate con pierna extendida y forma de dragón, con patadas encadenadas.
Postura de aterrizaje con la pierna bien estirada y abierta.

prereqNotes.fullFeilong: El Full Feilong te da el giro completo con la pierna extendida de dragón; acá solo sumas la patada extra.

detailEn.summary: It is a full shaped like a feilong, with one leg extended like a dragon. It completes the double turn and adds one more kick before landing in mega.

before.prerequisites: You need the Full Feilong. That trick gives you the full turn with the dragon leg; here you add the extra kick.
before.space: A large mat or a trampoline. An elite trick.

body.feet: Enter with a step and a high jump. The kicking foot stays back.
body.legs: One leg travels extended like a dragon during the turn and adds the extra kick at the end.
body.arms: The arms open the turn and follow the kicks.
body.gaze: The gaze passes over the shoulder during the turn and finds the floor on the finish.
body.torso: The torso tilts and stays long during the turn.

steps.title: Entry
steps.body: Take the step and rise, starting the full with the dragon leg.

steps.title: Feilong turn
steps.body: Complete the turn keeping the leg extended like a dragon.

steps.title: Extra kick
steps.body: Add the extra kick at the end of the rotation.

steps.title: Mega landing
steps.body: Land in mega stance, with the leg extended and soft knees.

detailEn.landing: Land in mega stance, with the leg extended and the chest up. If the rotation falls short, do not force the kick.
mistakes: Bending the feilong leg.
Losing height on the double turn.
Opening the finish too late.
tips: Practice the Full Feilong until the turn with the extended leg is solid.
Then add the extra kick.
Use a trampoline for the landing.

terms.meaning: A finish with an extended leg in a dragon shape, with chained kicks.
A landing stance with the leg fully extended and open.

prereqNotes.fullFeilong: The Full Feilong gives you the full turn with the extended dragon leg; here you only add the extra kick.

fullHyperhookTurbo.es: Es un Full Hyperhook que aterriza de frente sobre los dos pies. El gancho es el mismo, pero la salida es turbo.
fullHyperhookTurbo.en: It is a Full Hyperhook that lands facing forward on both feet. The hook is the same, but the exit is turbo.

detailEs.summary: Es un full hyperhook en versión turbo, con el gancho tardío y acelerado. El giro completo se acelera y el gancho sale al final antes del aterrizaje.

before.prerequisites: Necesitas el Full Hyperhook. Primero domina el giro con el gancho antes de cambiar la salida.
before.space: Colchoneta amplia. El giro es rápido, deja espacio libre.

body.feet: Entrada de un pie con salto alto. El pie de pateo queda atrás.
body.legs: Las piernas giran recogidas y al final una engancha; las dos preparan la caída de frente.
body.arms: Los brazos se recogen para girar y acompañan el gancho.
body.gaze: La mirada pasa por encima del hombro y busca el horizonte al enganchar.
body.torso: El torso se mantiene alto y firme durante el giro rápido.

steps.title: Entrada
steps.body: Da el paso y sube, arrancando el full.

steps.title: Giro acelerado
steps.body: Completa los 360 grados dejando que el giro se acelere al final.

steps.title: Hyperhook
steps.body: Engancha una pierna en hiperextensión justo antes de caer.

steps.title: Aterrizaje turbo
steps.body: Cae de frente sobre los dos pies con las rodillas blandas.

detailEs.landing: Cae de frente sobre los dos pies, con las rodillas flexionadas y el pecho arriba.
mistakes: Frenar el giro antes del gancho.
Caer en un solo pie por costumbre.
Aterrizar con las rodillas bloqueadas.
tips: Practica la salida turbo sola, como un salto de dos pies.
Después agrega el giro y el gancho.
Usa una colchoneta para la caída de frente.

terms.meaning: Patada de enganche con la pierna estirada y la cadera abierta.
Salida que aterriza de frente sobre las dos piernas.

prereqNotes.fullHyperhook: El Full Hyperhook te da el giro completo con el gancho; el Turbo solo cambia la salida.

detailEn.summary: It is a full hyperhook in the turbo version, with a late accelerated hook. The full turn speeds up and the hook swings out at the end before landing.

before.prerequisites: You need the Full Hyperhook. First master the turn with the hook before changing the exit.
before.space: A large mat. The turn is fast, leave room.

body.feet: One-foot entry with a high jump. The kicking foot stays back.
body.legs: The legs turn tucked and at the end one hooks; both prepare the forward landing.
body.arms: The arms tuck to turn and follow the hook.
body.gaze: The gaze passes over the shoulder and finds the horizon on the hook.
body.torso: The torso stays tall and firm during the fast turn.

steps.title: Entry
steps.body: Take the step and rise, starting the full.

steps.title: Accelerated turn
steps.body: Complete the 360 degrees, letting the turn speed up at the end.

steps.title: Hyperhook
steps.body: Hook one leg in hyperextension just before landing.

steps.title: Turbo landing
steps.body: Land facing forward on both feet with soft knees.

detailEn.landing: Land facing forward on both feet, with bent knees and the chest up.
mistakes: Braking the turn before the hook.
Landing on one foot out of habit.
Landing with locked knees.
tips: Practice the turbo exit alone, like a two-foot jump.
Then add the turn and the hook.
Use a mat for the forward landing.

terms.meaning: A hooking kick with the leg extended and the hip open.
An exit that lands facing forward on both legs.

prereqNotes.fullHyperhook: The Full Hyperhook gives you the full turn with the hook; the Turbo only changes the exit.
